Text: Scheduling PolicyPurposeThis document describes the appointment scheduling process for DeepHealth clinics.Appointment BookingPatients may schedule appointments through the online portal, by phone, or through referral requests.Schedulers must verify patient identity before creating an appointment.Provider AvailabilitySchedulers must review provider availability before confirming an appointment.Appointments may only be scheduled within approved provider time slots.Appointment ConfirmationAfter an appointment is created, the patient receives an email confirmation and a text message notification.Cancellation PolicyPatients may cancel appointments up to 24 hours before the scheduled appointment time.Late cancellations are recorded in the patient's scheduling history.ReschedulingPatients may request rescheduling through the scheduling portal or by contacting the schedulingdepartment.Schedulers should offer the earliest available appointment slot that meets the patient's needs.EscalationsScheduling issues that cannot be resolved by a scheduler should be escalated to the Scheduling OperationsManager.1

Radiology WorkflowPurposeThis document describes the radiology imaging workflow.Imaging OrdersProviders submit imaging orders through the electronic health record system.Scheduling ImagingRadiology appointments are scheduled only after an imaging order has been approved.MRI ProceduresMRI scans require completion of a safety screening questionnaire.CT ProceduresCT scans requiring contrast must include kidney function assessment documentation.Image ReviewImages are reviewed by a radiologist before final reports are released.Report DeliveryRadiology reports are delivered electronically to the ordering provider.EscalationsUrgent findings must be escalated immediately to the Radiology Medical Director.1
